title: "DICOM Metadata"
jupyter: python3
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{python message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
#| output: asis
#| echo: false


import re
import pandas as pd
import pydicom
from pydicom.datadict import dictionary_has_tag, keyword_for_tag, dictionary_description
from pydicom.tag import Tag
from IPython.display import HTML


def extract_dicom_tags_from_content(content):
    """Extract DICOM tags from the provided content."""
    pattern = r'<e\s+en="T"\s+t="([0-9A-Fa-f]{8})"'
    matches = re.findall(pattern, content)
    unique_tags = []
    seen = set()
    for tag in matches:
        if tag not in seen:
            unique_tags.append(tag)
            seen.add(tag)
    return unique_tags


def get_tag_info(tag_string):
    """Get DICOM tag information using pydicom."""
    try:
        group = int(tag_string[:4], 16)
        element = int(tag_string[4:], 16)
        tag = Tag(group, element)
        if dictionary_has_tag(tag):
            keyword = keyword_for_tag(tag)
            description = dictionary_description(tag)
            return {
                'tag_number': f"({group:04X},{element:04X})",
                'tag_hex': tag_string.upper(),
                'keyword': keyword,
                'description': description
            }
        else:
            return {
                'tag_number': f"({group:04X},{element:04X})",
                'tag_hex': tag_string.upper(),
                'keyword': 'Unknown',
                'description': 'Tag not found in DICOM dictionary'
            }
    except Exception as e:
        return {
            'tag_number': tag_string,
            'tag_hex': tag_string.upper(),
            'keyword': 'Error',
            'description': f'Error processing tag: {e}'
        }


provided_content = open("metadata.xml", "r").read()
tag_strings = extract_dicom_tags_from_content(provided_content)

results = []
for tag_string in tag_strings:
    tag_info = get_tag_info(tag_string)
    results.append({
        'DICOM_Tag_Number': tag_info['tag_number'],
        'DICOM_Tag_Name': tag_info['keyword'],
        'DICOM_Tag_Description': tag_info['description']
    })

df = pd.DataFrame(results)
HTML(df.to_html(escape=False, table_id="df", index=False))
```

## Preserved Private Tags

These private elements are preserved verbatim during de-identification, keyed on the private-creator string. All other private elements are removed.

Source: [`dicom-dre` default profile (commit 58cd116)](https://github.com/susom/dicom-dre/blob/58cd11694610f7e9a228906bb9c451bb6b94e0d5/src/dicom_dre/profiles/default.py)

::: {.panel-tabset}

## Strict Profile Tags

Tags defined in the [`dicom-dre` strict profile](https://github.com/susom/dicom-dre/blob/main/src/dicom_dre/profiles/strict.py). This profile removes all unspecified elements and strips dates entirely (no jitter). UIDs are re-hashed without a study-ID salt.

::: {.panel-tabset}
